limits: 39 exact Stop text equality receipts; raw complete transcripts are not exported here. Original reference bytes are bound, but equality is native internal evidence.
72 decoder comparisons mean full original PCM input equality, not transcript accuracy. CancelCapture has no decode; CancelDecoderEntry finishes real decode but discards cancelled text.
Resource pacing is feed summaries only, not all publication records or Stop ingress/L/p95 measurement. Barriers and OS sampling alter workload timing.
RSS is residency, not active allocator bytes or a leak proof; no arbitrary threshold, no universal leak-free/resource qualification. MLX active/cache counters are not sampled by this unchanged probe.

Final RSS checkpoint precedes cleanup; normal worker finish/join has separate evidence, no exported after-join-RSS sample. time-l RSS/footprint are whole-process maxima, not phases; do not add overlapping metrics.
AC/policy observations are finite samples, not continuous thermal/load/energy proof. Caffeinate receipt proves reported reap, no separate PID exported.
Large model/bin/kernel bytes retain previously verified freeze hashes and unchanged stat witnesses; no heavy blob rehash or new measurement.
loadMicros stops before shared::wait_ready; the model initializer runs asynchronously on the permanent worker. This field is spawn/setup time, not complete model load time.
V1 preparation failure occurred before ASR and remains separate; no overwritten old raw evidence or retry implied. Rest94/bundle/default/offline/product gates remain separate.
loadMicrosScope: Runtime/service spawn and setup before shared::wait_ready; excludes complete asynchronous worker/model-ready wait; not model loading latency.
